high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media platform, likely X (formerly known as Twitter). The post is from a user named "Curiosity" (@MAstronomers), who has verified status indicated by the blue checkmark next to their name. The post was made 14 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The content of the post includes a caption that reads: "Aurora was so bright the ground turned green." Below the caption, there is an image of a vibrant green aurora borealis (Northern Lights) illuminating the night sky. The aurora is prominently displayed, with a gradient of green hues
